story: Malibu Creek State Park preserves the Malibu Creek canyon in the Santa Monica Mountains of California. Established in 1974 and opened in 1976, the 8,215-acre park spans across nature preserves and includes the site of a village called Talepop.
matters: The park is a component of the Santa Monica Mountains National Recreation Area, connecting public parkland and linking to the region's long history of native Chumash inhabitants.
name: Malibu Creek State Park
